title: MyJewl perception-lane acknowledgement v0.1
description: An operator's dated, named, expiring acknowledgement that MyJewl's perception lane (Track C, paused 2026-08-11) may serve DIAGNOSTIC output on this deployment despite every Goal 0005 gate reading not_measurable. It is a PERMISSION and nothing else. It grants no accuracy, moves no gate, makes no gate measurable, and never certifies manufacturing. Conditions are accepted individually by slug -- there is deliberately no wildcard, so a condition discovered after this file was signed is refused rather than covered by it. The committed template acknowledges nothing and refuses the lane, exactly as the shop-profile and alloy-price-sheet templates refuse their own values.

status.description: Only 'declared' can enable the lane. 'undeclared' is the shipped state and refuses.

declared_by.description: A named human. An unattributed acknowledgement is not an acknowledgement.

validity.description: An acknowledgement MUST expire. A permission that never lapses becomes invisible, which is the same failure mode as a stale price that still looks live (Goal 0024).

accepted_conditions.description: The refusal slugs this operator has read and accepted, individually. A live condition absent from this list refuses with condition_not_acknowledged. No wildcard is permitted, for the same reason Goal 0024 refuses a wildcard alloy: a blanket accept silently covers whatever is discovered next.

understands.description: Each must be literally true. They are const-true rather than free text so the file cannot be signed while disagreeing with what MyJewl will actually do.
